components.name: Button
components.summary: Button — triggers an action
components.description: Button — triggers an action. Use `primary` once per screen for the main action, `secondary` for alternatives, `tertiary` for low-emphasis actions and `destructive` for delete/remove. Use `size="lg"` for main screen actions and `size="md"` inside cards and rows. For navigation to another page, prefer a link (`asChild`).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis (Figma `Variant`). - `primary` — the one main action on a screen - `secondary` — alternative actions - `tertiary` — low-emphasis text action - `destructive` — deletes or removes something

props.name: size
props.description: Height (Figma `Size`). `lg` = 52 px for main screen actions; `md` = 44 px inside cards and rows.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label (Figma `Leading icon`). Use an `Icon` or Lucide icon; sized to 20 px.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label (Figma `Trailing icon`), e.g. a chevron for "continue".

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (e.g. a router `<Link>`) with button styles instead of a `<button>`.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Icon — the 12 Startline icons: 24 px outline, 1.8 px stroke at every size (like Figma), coloured by the surrounding text colour (`currentColor`)
components.description: Icon — the 12 Startline icons: 24 px outline, 1.8 px stroke at every size (like Figma), coloured by the surrounding text colour (`currentColor`). Size follows `size-*` classes (default 24 px; Button sets 20 px). Directional icons (chevron-right) mirror automatically in right-to-left layouts. Interactive icons need a 44 px target — put them inside Button or BackButton, never alone. For an icon that is not in this set, use `lucide-react` with `strokeWidth={1.8}`.

props.name: name
props.description: Which Startline icon (Figma `Name`).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Omit for decorative icons next to text (they are hidden from screen readers). Set it when the icon is the only content of a control or conveys meaning on its own.

components.name: AppIcon
components.summary: App icon — white pathmark on the brand teal tile, 28/128 corner radius
components.description: App icon — white pathmark on the brand teal tile, 28/128 corner radius. Fixed brand colours (does not change with themes). Size with `size-*` classes (default 64 px).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name.

components.name: LogoLockup
components.summary: Logo lockup — pathmark + "Startline" wordmark (Plus Jakarta Sans Medium, −2 % tracking)
components.description: Logo lockup — pathmark + "Startline" wordmark (Plus Jakarta Sans Medium, −2 % tracking). Proportions come from Figma and scale together via `markSize`.

props.name: layout
props.description: Figma `Layout`. `horizontal` for headers; `stacked` for splash and empty states.

props.name: theme
props.description: Figma `Theme`.

props.name: markSize
props.description: Height of the symbol in px; the wordmark scales with it (Figma: 76 horizontal, 96 stacked).

components.name: LogoMark
components.summary: Logo mark — the Startline pathmark symbol alone
components.description: Logo mark — the Startline pathmark symbol alone. Preserve its geometry; never recolour it outside the three themes. Size with `size-*` / `h-*` classes (default 48 px).

props.name: theme
props.description: Figma `Theme`. `color` on light or dark app surfaces (brand gradients); `mono` one-colour (Text/Primary); `inverse` on brand-filled surfaces (Text/Inverse).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to "Startline". Pass `""` when the mark sits next to the wordmark.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Avatar — represents a person with their initials or a generic icon
components.description: Avatar — represents a person with their initials or a generic icon.

props.name: initials
props.description: Up to 2 letters shown in the circle (Figma `Initials`).

props.name: type
props.description: Figma `Type`. `initials` shows the letters; `icon` shows a generic person icon.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma `Size`: sm 32 px, md 40 px, lg 48 px.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's full name, read by screen readers. Omit only when the name is shown next to the avatar.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: Search field — single-line input for searching resources or lists, with a search icon and an optional clear button
components.description: Search field — single-line input for searching resources or lists, with a search icon and an optional clear button. Use Text field for form data entry. Figma `Query` is the placeholder (Default state) or the value (Filled state). Always give it an accessible name: `aria-label` or a visible `<label htmlFor>`.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma `Size`: md 44 px, lg 52 px.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called by the clear button. The button (Figma `Show clear`) appears when this is set and the field has a value.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer field (the input itself gets `className`).

components.example: <SearchField aria-label="Search resources" placeholder="Search" value={q} onChange={…} onClear={() => setQ("")} />

components.name: TextField
components.summary: Text field — persistent label, editable value and optional helper
components.description: Text field — persistent label, editable value and optional helper. The error state explains how to recover. 52 px control. Do not use Guidance card as a form field. Figma `Value` is the placeholder (Default state) or the value (Filled state).

props.name: label
props.description: Persistent visible label above the field (Figma `Label`). Required — never rely on placeholder alone.

props.name: helper
props.description: Helper text under the field (Figma `Helper` + `Show helper`).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (Figma `State=Error`). When set, the field turns red, the message replaces the helper and is announced to screen readers. Explain how to fix it, not just what is wrong.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (the input itself gets `className`).

components.example: <TextField label="Provider or contact" placeholder="Enter a name" helper="Check the details before saving" />

components.name: Switch
components.summary: Switch — turns a setting on or off immediately, without a Save button
components.description: Switch — turns a setting on or off immediately, without a Save button. Use for preferences; use Choice card for questions. Give it a name with a `<label htmlFor>` or `aria-label` (inside a Settings row the row label does this). 44×26 px; touch area extended to 46 px tall. Figma `Checked` → `checked` / `defaultChecked`; `State=Disabled` → `disabled`.

components.name: ChoiceCard
components.summary: Choice card — a large tappable option with label and optional helper, for onboarding and questionnaires
components.description: Choice card — a large tappable option with label and optional helper, for onboarding and questionnaires. `single` behaves as a radio button, `multiple` as a checkbox (native inputs, so keyboard and screen readers work). Wrap a group in `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` question. Use Switch for instant settings.

props.name: label
props.description: Main text (Figma `Label`).

props.name: helper
props.description: Supporting text under the label (Figma `Helper` + `Show helper`).

props.name: selection
props.description: Figma `Selection`. `single` = pick one (radio — give all cards in a group the same `name`); `multiple` = pick several (checkbox).

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new checked state (Figma `State=Selected`).

components.example:
<fieldset><legend>What do you need help with first?</legend>
  <ChoiceCard name="priority" value="housing" label="Housing" helper="Find a place to live" />
  <ChoiceCard name="priority" value="health" label="Health" />
</fieldset>

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Badge — short, read-only status label (Neutral, Info, Success, Warning, Error) with an optional dot
components.description: Badge — short, read-only status label (Neutral, Info, Success, Warning, Error) with an optional dot. Always pair colour with a meaningful word. Use Chip for filters, Source indicator for provenance.

props.name: status
props.description: Figma `Status`.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma `Size`: sm 24 px, md 32 px.

props.name: dot
props.description: Figma `Show dot`.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Chip — a selectable filter
components.description: Chip — a selectable filter. Selected = filter on; Disabled = unavailable (not the same as unselected). Use in a row above lists. Use Badge for read-only status.

props.name: selected
props.description: Figma `State=Selected` — the filter is on. Announced as "pressed".

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the new selected state when the chip is clicked.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma `Size`: sm 36 px (44 px touch area), md 44 px.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Figma `Show leading icon` — usually `<Icon name="check" />` on selected chips.

components.name: SourceIndicator
components.summary: Source indicator — shows where information comes from, to build trust
components.description: Source indicator — shows where information comes from, to build trust. Place it next to facts and AI answers. The label (Figma `Label`) is the children, e.g. "Official source", "Updated 3 May".

props.name: kind
props.description: Figma `Kind` — where the information comes from: `official` (government or the service itself), `verified` (checked by Startline), `updated` (last-updated date), `ai-summary` (written by AI — always show this on AI text).

props.name: size
props.description: Figma `Size`: sm 24 px, md 32 px.

components.name: TaskCard
components.summary: Task card — one next step on the user's path: status tag, title, optional description and meta, and an action
components.description: Task card — one next step on the user's path: status tag, title, optional description and meta, and an action. Use for actionable steps; use Guidance card for information without an action. Show at most one `next` card at a time.

props.name: state
props.description: Figma `State`: `next` = do now (highlighted), `upcoming` = later, `complete` = done.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma `Title`.

props.name: description
props.description: Figma `Description` (+ `Show description`).

props.name: meta
props.description: Figma `Meta` (+ `Show meta`), e.g. "Recommended today". Shown with a calendar icon.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Figma `Action label`, e.g. "Start this step".

props.name: actionHref
props.description: Makes the action a link.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Makes the action a button.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Status tag text. Defaults to English "Next step" / "Upcoming" / "Complete" — pass translations.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading level of the title, to fit the page outline.

components.example:
<TaskCard state="next" title="Apply for a Social Insurance Number" description="You need a SIN to work in Canada."
  meta="Recommended today" actionLabel="Start this step" actionHref="/steps/sin" />

components.name: ResourceListItem
components.summary: Resource list item — a service or resource (provider, title, description, source) for comparison in a list
components.description: Resource list item — a service or resource (provider, title, description, source) for comparison in a list. `emphasis="recommended"` highlights the best match. Put several in a `<ul>`.

props.name: provider
props.description: Figma `Provider`, e.g. "Government resource".

props.name: title
props.description: Figma `Title`.

props.name: description
props.description: Figma `Description`.

props.name: kind
props.description: Figma `Kind`: `resource` (official information) or `service` (verified service provider).

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Figma `Emphasis`: `recommended` highlights the best match (max one per list).

props.name: sourceLabel
props.description: Source tag text. Defaults to English "Official source" / "Verified service" — pass translations.

props.name: recommendedLabel
props.description: Text of the recommended tag.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole item a link.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading level of the title.

components.example: <ResourceListItem provider="Government resource" title="Newcomer services" description="…" href="/r/1" />

components.name: GuidanceCard
components.summary: Guidance card — supporting information with no task action
components.description: Guidance card — supporting information with no task action. Let text wrap; do not truncate. Not a form field and not a task (use Task card when there is something to do).

props.name: title
props.description: Figma `Title`.

props.name: body
props.description: Figma `Body` (+ `Show body`).

props.name: layout
props.description: Figma `Layout`: `card` standalone; `row` inside a grouped list (no box); `tile` compact, for a two-column grid of categories.

props.name: tone
props.description: Figma `Tone`: `info` tints helpful tips.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading level of the title.

components.example: <GuidanceCard tone="info" title="Prepare for your next step" body="Keep useful details together…" />

components.name: SettingsRow
components.summary: Settings row — a row in a settings list with label, current value and chevron; opens a detail screen
components.description: Settings row — a row in a settings list with label, current value and chevron; opens a detail screen. Figma `State`: Pressed is the CSS :active state; Disabled → `disabled`. Group rows in a list; for instant on/off use a Switch with its own label instead.

props.name: label
props.description: Figma `Label`, e.g. "Language".

props.name: value
props.description: Figma `Value` — the current setting, e.g. "English".

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the row a link to the detail screen (otherwise a button with `onClick`).

components.name: BackButton
components.summary: Back button — 44 px round button that returns to the previous screen
components.description: Back button — 44 px round button that returns to the previous screen. Use top-start on detail screens without bottom navigation. Not a general icon button. Mirrors in right-to-left layouts. Figma `State=Pressed` is the CSS :active state.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Back" or "Back to Resources". Translate it.

components.name: BottomNavigation
components.summary: Bottom navigation — fixed tab bar for the 5 primary destinations (Home, My Path, Ask, Resources, Profile)
components.description: Bottom navigation — fixed tab bar for the 5 primary destinations (Home, My Path, Ask, Resources, Profile). Only on top-level screens; detail screens use Back button. Keep it fixed below the scrolling content. Each item is a 44 px target; the current one is marked `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: active
props.description: Figma `Active` — the current destination.

props.name: items
props.type: Partial<Record<Destination, { label?: string | undefined; href?: string | undefined; }>>
props.description: Translated labels and/or real URLs per destination. Defaults: English labels, `/`, `/path`, `/ask`, `/resources`, `/profile`.

props.name: linkAs
props.description: Link element to render (e.g. your router's `Link`). Receives `href`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

components.name: AskStartlineAction
components.summary: Ask Startline action — opens the AI assistant with the current context
components.description: Ask Startline action — opens the AI assistant with the current context. Use only where an AI answer can help with that content. The label (Figma `Label`) is the children; default "Ask Startline".

props.name: format
props.description: Figma `Format`: `compact` = filled pill inside cards; `contextual` = quiet text action under content.

components.name: AIAssistantPanel
components.summary: AI Assistant Panel — one step of an AI conversation
components.description: AI Assistant Panel — one step of an AI conversation. Separates AI guidance from source evidence and human support. Rules: always label AI text with `<SourceIndicator kind="ai-summary">`, always show the sources it used, and offer human help (`escalation`) when the answer depends on legal, immigration or eligibility decisions. Never present AI text as official.

props.name: state
props.description: Figma `State`: - `entry` — invite a question (highlighted): heading, intro, suggested questions, Ask action. - `answer` — AI answer: the question, an "AI summary" SourceIndicator, the answer, sources, actions. - `escalation` — hand-off to a human when a decision depends on the person's situation.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Header subtitle, e.g. "AI navigation assistant", "Answer with sources", "When confirmation matters".

props.name: footnote
props.description: Small print at the bottom, e.g. "The linked source remains authoritative."

props.name: children
props.description: Panel content — compose it from Startline components (see stories).

components.example:
I just arrived in Ontario. What should I do first? AI summary · sources shown

…

props.description: Small label above the question. Translate it.

components.name: AIAssistantSuggestions
components.summary: Suggested questions in an `entry` panel.
components.description: Suggested questions in an `entry` panel.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Suggested questions, shown as chips (Figma: 3 small Chips stacked).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen question.
